verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a hosted API product. The only hint of versioning is a '/v1/' segment in the Voice Agent endpoint URL. The pack contains no documentation of an API versioning scheme and no deprecation policy, which is the core of the story. A version path segment alone does not show a documented versioning or deprecation commitment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
